reason: No change on macOS/Linux to builtin.c, path_virtualization.c and getcurrentdir/fileexists (iOS-guarded or include-only), and the path_truncate.c change has no caller in the aether build; but yyjson_builtins.c (YyjsonReadFile, AetherTryToonReadFile) and sqlite_builtins.c vmSqliteOpen now route their path through pscalPathVirtualized_hostPath, an identity inline off iOS, in code Aether programs run.
The vm.c pthread_testcancel() sits inside #if defined(PSCAL_TARGET_IOS) in interpretBytecode; vproc.h only adds a vprocEndAbandoned declaration and a desktop no-op stub no aether-build code calls.

builtin_network_api.c on every non-Windows build: vmBuiltinSocketPoll (Aether's socket_poll) and socketWaitReadable move from select to poll; socket_poll now fails with EINVAL on a negative timeout and counts POLLHUP/POLLERR as ready.
Only vproc.h is in the aether build: new vprocHaltSession/vprocTaskHalting declarations and desktop stubs, called only from shell_word_expansion.inc.
vm.c interpretBytecode dispatch (VM_NEXT_SIMPLE skips top-of-loop checks), freeValue's inline scalar fast path and vmStoreThroughAddress's same-type scalar store, all unguarded.
builtin.h only adds the prototype vmBuiltinShellJobText; its definition and registration are in shell sources outside the aether build.

builtin.c vmEnableRawMode and vmRestoreTerminal, outside any iOS guard: base termios re-read each time raw mode starts, per-thread restore; reached by Aether's readkey and by every program through atexit vmAtExitCleanup.
builtin.h adds a shell_task field to ShellCwdScope used only by shell code; vproc.h adds declarations and desktop no-op stubs called only by shell and vproc.c.

path_virtualization changes are in its PSCAL_TARGET_IOS-only body; vproc.h additions are read only by vproc.c; path_truncate.c pathTruncateRefreshProc writes the same text and has no caller in the aether build.
vproc.h only adds vprocWriteShimNoSignal and a desktop stub that is plain write(); the SIGPIPE logic and callers are in vproc.c and shell_builtins.inc.
vproc.h only adds declarations and desktop pass-through shims (lchown, utimensat, linkat, mkstemp, mkdtemp) used by vproc.c and vproc_shim.h, outside the aether build.

Unguarded: compiler.c's assignment precision warning now ranks a TYPE_WIDECHAR target as 32 bits (Aether uses WIDECHAR for non-ASCII chars); vm.c vmStoreUnicodeChar and the single-byte char store accept integer values for every front end.

vmFrontendHidesShellBuiltins includes FRONTEND_KIND_AETHER with no iOS guard, so query_builtin.c vmBuiltinHasExtBuiltin now answers false for category "shell"; before, Aether's has_builtin("shell", "socket_create") answered true on macOS. The ExtBuiltin listings and preproc.c run the new filter too.
builtin_network_api.c socketConsumeInterrupt, used by every blocking socket wait, now also stops on vm->abort_requested or the thread owner's flag; no frontend or platform guard.

strinsert/strdelete stay hidden from Aether, but vmBuiltinHiddenFromFrontend (called from getVmBuiltinID, isBuiltin, getVmBuiltinHandlerById) was rewritten around per-language bits, and the static dispatch table gains two entries, shifting the ids of dynamically registered builtins.

vm.c copyValueForStack takes real copies of strings, sets, records, enums and static arrays while any thread job runs (Aether's par and threads use them); types.h ArrayObj gains a pins field read by utils.c valueCowHeader; unguarded.
Only vproc.h is in the aether build; off iOS it gains no-op inline stubs (vprocReplaceStdio, vprocPassChildrenToParent) whose only callers are shell_execution.inc and vproc.c.
builtin.h only gains the declaration shellRuntimeSetPromptStatus; body and callers are in shell/shell_runtime_state.inc (exsh).

env_snapshot.c's new walk and rewritten snapshot take/restore are called only from shell/*.inc and path_truncate.c's /proc environ writer, which off iOS is reachable only through the iOS-only path_virtualization.c and sdl.c (SDL off).

findUnitFile in utils.c is Pascal-only, but the new pscalLibDirBesideExecutable is called by rea's tryResolveRelativePath, which every Aether `use` runs through resolveModulePath, so it can change which module an import finds (<exe>/../lib/rea).

cache.c's new cacheSourceIsFile (stat, S_ISREG, not iOS-guarded) gates loadBytecodeFromCache and saveBytecodeToCache, which rea main.c calls for Aether unless --no-cache: /dev/stdin or /dev/fd/N sources now skip the cache; builtin.c vmReadLineInterruptible's desktop fd<0 early return changes too.

builtin.c vmThreadCleanup's non-iOS branch restores termios from a per-thread record; vmEnableRawMode and vmPrepareCanonicalInput go through vmNoteRawMode/vmThreadTerm; reached by aether_read_line and readkey/keypressed.
vm.c CALL_BUILTIN_PROC adds a strcmp before the strcasecmp in the id_name_mismatch check: behaviour-preserving, in the builtin-call path every Aether program runs.

builtin.c rewrites the registry lookups Aether uses (getVmBuiltinID, getVmBuiltinHandlerById, getVmBuiltinEffectMaskById, isBuiltin) around shellViewOfId; results should not change on desktop, but it is a refactor of the lookup; query_builtin.c adds a frontendIsAether() skip of the shell category.

The mount table and /proc/mounts writer in path_truncate.c are reached only through the iOS-only path_virtualization.c, vproc.c, the shell or sdl.c; the statfs/statvfs wrappers sit inside the iOS block.
The /proc/<pid>/fd writer in path_truncate.c is procfs provisioning only the iOS path virtualization reaches; vproc.h only gains declarations for vproc.c.
builtin.c vmInitTerminalState now skips vmEnableRawMode unless vmTerminalIsOurs(); reached from rea main.c with no front-end guard, but only when PSCAL_INIT_TERM is set and not 0.

vm.c vmMarkAbortRequested and vmHandleGlobalInterrupt set the new ended_by_interrupt field, which vmRunWasInterrupted returns and rea main.c uses for Aether's Ctrl-C exit 130; vmBuiltinReadkey and vmReadLineInterruptible change on non-iOS paths too.
builtin.c vmBuiltinFopen takes a char for path or mode through fopenArgText; fopen is a Core builtin Aether can call (in the full guide's appendix, not removed).

builtin.c appends five entries to the static dispatch table, moving every registered extra builtin's id (Aether's aether_* builtins among them) and so the compiled bytecode; getVmBuiltinID, getVmBuiltinHandlerById and isBuiltin consult vmBuiltinHiddenFromFrontend, which names FRONTEND_KIND_AETHER; compiler.c parts are frontendIsPascal()-guarded.
ast.h's new open_arrays_rebased is read only by pascalRebaseOpenArrayParams behind frontendIsPascal(); on Aether's nodes newASTNode and copyASTRecursive only set or copy it.

builtin.c populateBuiltinRegistry registers PollKeyAny as a function in non-SDL builds; before, an Aether call to pollkeyany compiled and then stopped with "Undefined global variable", and builtins_json listed its kind as unknown.

builtin.c readKeyFetchConsoleByte (ReadKey's ESC handling) and getCursorPosition (wherex/wherey) now call vmStdinFcntl, plain fcntl off iOS: a behaviour-preserving refactor of Aether-callable builtins.
Only a builtin.h declaration of shellRuntimeKeepLineState, defined and called only in shell/shell_runtime_state.inc.
Only a builtin.h declaration of shellRuntimeChunkLeftStages, used only by exsh .inc files.

rea semantic.c tryResolveRelativePath, unguarded and on Aether's `use` path, now also searches <exe>/../lib/rea before REA_DEFAULT_IMPORT_DIR, so an import can resolve to a different file or resolve where it failed.

mkfifo/mknod wrappers sit inside path_virtualization.c's iOS block; vproc.h's non-iOS getrlimit/setrlimit inlines are called only by the shell's ulimit; the builtin.h additions are read only by shell code.
builtin.c changes (vmVprocPipeOpen, vmVprocStreamOpen) are all inside the PSCAL_TARGET_IOS block; vproc.h only adds a non-iOS inline no aether code calls.

landscape.c registerLandscapeBuiltins now registers landscapeshadersavailable outside #ifdef SDL (false with SDL off), callable by name and listed in the user ext category: a change to the builtin registry Aether looks up and to the ids of builtins registered after it.
Every vprocKillLive swap and the vprocTaskKilledHere check sit inside PSCAL_TARGET_IOS blocks in builtin.c and vm.c; vproc.h only adds non-iOS stubs no non-shell aether code calls.
net_snapshot.c is called only from path_truncate.c's /proc/net refresh, reached only from the shell, the iOS-only path virtualization, vproc.c, nextvi and sdl.c.
cache.c ensureCacheDirectory, on Aether's cached path, now passes $HOME through pscalPathVirtualized_hostPath, the identity off iOS: behaviour-preserving, in code Aether runs.

vmBuiltinReadkey under #if !defined(PSCAL_TARGET_IOS): a pending SIGINT or a 0x03 byte now leaves the interrupt to the VM instead of setting exit_requested, so Ctrl-C in readkey ends the program and changes the exit status.
rea main.c is Aether's entry point; reaHandleSigint sets ended_by_interrupt and the run exits 130 via vmRunWasInterrupted instead of 0.

The new compile error is behind frontendIsPascal(); the one unguarded change (an errorsBefore early break in compileStatement's PROC_CALL_INDIRECT fallback) acts only after a compile error, on a path Aether's semantic pass rules out (FUNC-001).

compiler.c logic is frontendIsPascal()-gated, but builtin.c appends __pascal_to_ordinal to the static dispatch table, shifting the id of every registered extra builtin Aether uses (aether_* stdlib, yyjson, sqlite) by one.
reaStringMethodBuiltin returns NULL unless frontendIsRea() (FRONTEND_KIND_REA only), so the new string-method compile paths never act for Aether (FRONTEND_KIND_AETHER).
